moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Premier League returns with a packed Saturday of fixtures, including Chelsea vs Hull City and Tottenham vs Everton, leading into a Manchester derby on Sunday.

angles.name: Saturday Match Buzz
angles.copy: Premier League is BACK! What game are you glued to this afternoon? Chelsea, Liverpool, Spurs all in action. #PL

angles.name: Manchester Derby Hype
angles.copy: Sunday's HUGE! It's Man Utd vs Man City in the first big derby of the season. Who's taking the bragging rights?

angles.name: Weekend Football Wrap
angles.copy: What a start to the Premier League weekend! Goals, drama, and big results. How did your team get on?

moments.title: Sienna Spiro Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' hits number one on the Official UK Singles Chart, making the 20-year-old the youngest British female to do so in 12 years. Miley Cyrus also enters the chart with 'Bass Persuades'.

angles.name: New Number One
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Sienna Spiro, hitting #1 with 'Great Expectation'! A new star is born on the UK charts.

angles.name: Miley's New Entry
angles.copy: Miley Cyrus is back in the Top 40 with 'Bass Persuades'! What do you think of her latest track?

angles.name: Dua Lipa Revival
angles.copy: Social media magic! Dua Lipa's 'Training Season' is back in the Top 10. Proof that a good track never dies.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 Launches
moments.blurb: The glitterball is back! Strictly Come Dancing returns for its 2026 launch show on Saturday, September 19th, promising a fresh line-up and new hosts.

angles.name: Strictly Countdown
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing returns next Saturday. Who are you excited to see on the dancefloor?

angles.name: New Hosts, New Season
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe take over as Strictly hosts! Big shoes to fill. Thoughts?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Season 17
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is back for its 17th series on Tuesday, September 22nd, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Tent Reopens
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! Great British Bake Off returns next Tuesday. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: New Bake Off Judge
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood in the Bake Off tent! A delicious addition to the judging panel. What do you think?

moments.title: Happy 67th, Morten Harket
moments.blurb: Morten Harket, the iconic frontman of Norwegian synth-pop band a-ha, celebrates his 67th birthday on September 14th.

angles.name: Take On Me Tributes
angles.copy: Happy 67th to a-ha's Morten Harket! Still hitting those impossibly high notes. What's your favourite a-ha track?

angles.name: A-ha's Enduring Appeal
angles.copy: 67 years young! Morten Harket, the voice behind 'Take On Me' and so many 80s classics. Still sounds as good as ever!

moments.title: Happy 69th, Jaki Graham
moments.blurb: British R&B and soul singer Jaki Graham, known for hits like 'Could It Be I'm Falling in Love', turns 69 on September 15th.

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 69th Birthday to the incredible Jaki Graham! Still got that amazing voice.

angles.name: 80s R&B Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Jaki Graham's 69th today! An 80s R&B queen who gave us some timeless tracks. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Happy 64th, Joanne Catherall
moments.blurb: Joanne Catherall, one of the vocalists from legendary synth-pop band The Human League, celebrates her 64th birthday on September 18th.

angles.name: Human League Icon
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to Joanne Catherall of The Human League! Still looking fabulous and sounding fantastic.

angles.name: Synth-Pop Legend
angles.copy: From 'Don't You Want Me' to 'Mirror Man', Joanne Catherall has been a part of pop history. Happy Birthday!

moments.title: Happy 74th, Nile Rodgers
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist, songwriter, and producer Nile Rodgers, co-founder of Chic and a hitmaker for countless artists, turns 74 on September 19th.

angles.name: Disco King's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 74th to the absolute legend, Nile Rodgers! From Chic to Bowie to Daft Punk, his guitar defined eras.

angles.name: Funk Master
angles.copy: The man behind the groove! Wishing Nile Rodgers a fantastic 74th Birthday. What's your favourite track he produced?

moments.title: Happy 54th, Liam Gallagher
moments.blurb: The iconic voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21st, continuing to make waves in the music scene.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll energy. What's your top Oasis anthem?

angles.name: Mad For It
angles.copy: Celebrating the legend that is Liam Gallagher today! 54 years young and still sounding biblical. Happy Birthday!

moments.title: Autumnal Equinox Arrives
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox officially marks the astronomical start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere on Tuesday, September 22nd.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Grab your pumpkin spice lattes! The Autumnal Equinox arrives next Tuesday, officially ushering in the new season.

angles.name: Longer Nights Ahead
angles.copy: From next Tuesday, the nights draw in as autumn officially begins. Time for cosy nights and crunchy leaves!
